arxiv-2108-02199.title: Common Envelope Mass Ejection in Evolved Stars: Modeling the Dust Emission from post-RGB stars in the LMC
arxiv-2108-02199.creator: Geetanjali Sarkar, Raghvendra Sahai
arxiv-2108-02199.description: Abstract Common Envelope (CE) systems are the result of Roche lobe overflow in interacting binaries. The subsequent evolution of the CE, its ejection and the formation of dust in its ejecta while the primary is on the Red Giant Branch (RGB), gives rise to a recently identified evolutionary class – dusty post-RGB stars.

arxiv-2112-15464.title: An explicit formula of powers of the 2 × 2 2\times 2 quantum matrices and its applications
arxiv-2112-15464.creator: Genki Shibukawa
arxiv-2112-15464.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Genki Shibukawa. We present an explicit formula of the powers for the 2 × 2 2\times 2 quantum matrices, that is a natural quantum analogue of the powers of the usual 2 × 2 2\times 2 matrices. As applications, we give some non-commutative relations of the entries of the powers for the 2 × 2 2\times 2 quantum matrices, which is a simple proof of the results of Vokos-Zumino-Wess (1990).

arxiv-2208-01870.title: Joint Optimization for Secure and Reliable Communications in Finite Blocklength Regime
arxiv-2208-01870.creator: Mintaek Oh, Jeonghun Park, Jinseok Choi
arxiv-2208-01870.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mintaek Oh, Jeonghun Park, Jinseok Choi. To realize ultra-reliable low latency communications with high spectral efficiency and security, we investigate a joint optimization problem for downlink communications with multiple users and eavesdroppers in the finite blocklength (FBL) regime. We formulate a multi-objective optimization problem to maximize a sum secrecy rate by developing a secure precoder and to minimize a maximum error probability and information leakage rate.

arxiv-2303-17538.title: Extremal jumps of circuit complexity of unitary evolutions generated by random Hamiltonians
arxiv-2303-17538.creator: Marcin Kotowski, Michał Oszmaniec, Michał Horodecki
arxiv-2303-17538.description: Abstract We investigate circuit complexity of unitaries generated by time evolution of randomly chosen strongly interacting Hamiltonians in finite dimensional Hilbert spaces. Specifically, we focus on two ensembles of random generators – the so called Gaussian Unitary Ensemble ( GUE \mathrm{GUE} ) and the ensemble of diagonal Gaussian matrices conjugated by Haar random unitary transformations.

arxiv-2305-18946.title: Casimir-Lifshitz force between graphene-based structures out of thermal equilibrium
arxiv-2305-18946.creator: Youssef Jeyar, Kevin Austry, Minggang Luo, Brahim Guizal, H. B. Chan, Mauro Antezza
arxiv-2305-18946.description: Abstract We study the non equilibrium Casimir-Lifshitz force between graphene-based parallel structures held at different temperatures and in presence of an external thermal bath at a third temperature. The graphene conductivity, which is itself a function of temperature, as well as of chemical potential, allows us to tune in situ the Casimir-Lifshitz force.

arxiv-2410-08003.title: More Experts Than Galaxies: Conditionally-Overlapping Experts with Biologically-Inspired Fixed Routing
arxiv-2410-08003.creator: Sagi Shaier, Francisco Pereira, Katharina von der Wense, Lawrence E Hunter, Matt Jones
arxiv-2410-08003.description: Abstract The evolution of biological neural systems has led to both modularity and sparse coding, which enables energy efficiency and robustness across the diversity of tasks in the lifespan. In contrast, standard neural networks rely on dense, non-specialized architectures, where all model parameters are simultaneously updated to learn multiple tasks, leading to interference.

arxiv-2410-09691.title: Robust 3D Point Clouds Classification based on Declarative Defenders
arxiv-2410-09691.creator: Kaidong Li, Tianxiao Zhang, Cuncong Zhong, Ziming Zhang, Guanghui Wang
arxiv-2410-09691.description: Abstract 3D point cloud classification requires distinct models from 2D image classification due to the divergent characteristics of the respective input data. While 3D point clouds are unstructured and sparse, 2D images are structured and dense. Bridging the domain gap between these two data types is a non-trivial challenge to enable model interchangeability.

arxiv-2509-18265.title: Instability of Laughlin FQH liquids into gapless power-law correlated states with continuous exponents in ideal Chern bands: rigorous results from plasma mapping
arxiv-2509-18265.creator: Saranyo Moitra, Inti Sodemann Villadiego

pmc-10754022.title: Bilateral orbital dermoid cysts: A case report
pmc-10754022.creator: Yi Lin, Jizhe Cui, Hui Zhang, Shiwei Huang
pmc-10754022.description: Dermoid cysts are one of the most common benign orbital tumours in children and usually occur unilaterally. Bilateral dermoid cysts in the orbit are rare. We report here, a case of bilateral orbital dermoid cysts, in a 29-month-old baby girl. The patient’s prognosis was favourable following surgical resection.

pmc-11309443.title: Uptake of human papilloma virus vaccination among adolescent girls living with HIV in Uganda: A mixed methods study
pmc-11309443.creator: Violet Nakibuuka, Martin Muddu, Jean Pierre Kraehenbuhl, Caroline Birungi, Fred C. Semitala, Andrew K. Tusubira, Aloysius Gonzaga Mubuuke, Aloysius Gonzaga Mubuuke, Aloysius Gonzaga Mubuuke, Aloysius Gonzaga Mubuuke, Aloysius Gonzaga Mubuuke, Aloysius Gonzaga Mubuuke
pmc-11309443.description: BackgroundHuman Papilloma Virus (HPV) vaccination can prevent more than 90% of cancers caused by HPV. Although this vaccination is recommended and provided at no cost to all adolescent girls aged 9 to19 years in Uganda, its uptake remains low. We sought to determine the uptake of, and factors associated with HPV vaccination among adolescent girls living with HIV in Uganda.

pmc-11782231.title: The role of Bacillus species in the management of plant-parasitic nematodes
pmc-11782231.creator: Prabhakaran Vasantha-Srinivasan, Ki Beom Park, Kil Yong Kim, Woo-Jin Jung, Yeon Soo Han
pmc-11782231.description: Plant-parasitic nematodes (PPNs), including root-knot nematodes (Meloidogyne spp.), cyst nematodes (Heterodera and Globodera spp.), and other economically significant nematode species, pose severe threats to global agriculture. These nematodes employ diverse survival strategies, such as dormancy in cysts or robust infective juvenile stages. Consequently, their management is challenging.

pmc-12542061.title: Fungal dynamics and lignocellulose depolymerization in Pinus koraiensis: impact of longhorn beetle infestation
pmc-12542061.creator: Yue Zhu, Sixun Ge, Lili Ren, Youqing Luo
pmc-12542061.description: Xylophagous insects, like Monochamus saltuarius significantly affect tree-stem-associated microbial communities and pose major threats to forest ecosystems. As a vector for the pinewood nematode (Bursaphelenchus xylophilus) and a wood-boring pest, M. saltuarius infests various Pinus species. Yet, the interactions between M. saltuarius-associated fungi and the endophytic fungi of its host tree, Pinus koraiensis, remain uncharacterized.

pmc-12593856.title: Impact of anxiety, depression and online mindfulness on IBD patients’ quality of life: a web-based cross-sectional survey and randomized pilot study
pmc-12593856.creator: Shurong Hu, Dingting Xu, Chunpeng Zhu, Yuqi Wang, Shuyan Li, Yan Chen, Caihua Wang, Yiping Chen
pmc-12593856.description: BackgroundIndividuals with Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) often suffer from psychological comorbidities, including symptoms of anxiety and depression, which contribute to a substantial impairment in quality of life (QOL). The potential benefits of online mindfulness interventions for IBD remain unexplored.ObjectiveStudy 1 (cross-sectional survey): To establish correlations between the severity of depression and anxiety and the QOL in IBD patients.

pmc-12652920.title: Mechanically Reinforced Silica Aerogels via Thermally Induced Phase Separation of Poly(ethylene-co-vinyl Alcohol)
pmc-12652920.creator: Hainan Ma, Baomin Wang, Yongjun Zhang, Liquan Zheng, István Lázár
pmc-12652920.description: Silica aerogels are highly attractive due to their outstanding properties, including their low density, ultralow thermal conductivity, large porosity, high optical transparency, and strong sorption activity. However, their inherent brittleness has limited widespread applications. Constructing a robust, highly porous three-dimensional network is critical to achieving the desired mechanical properties in aerogels.

pmc-13117084.title: Glyphosate Bioremediation Facilitated by Serratia ureilytica-Derived Biosurfactants Using Amazonian Biodiversity: Genomic Insights and Adsorption Dynamics

The strain S. ureilytica BM01-BS gave a biosurfactant yield of 3.

uslaw-usc-t36-s170303.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s170303.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 1703 (Pearl Harbor Survivors Association). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The purposes of the corporation are as provided in its articles of incorporation and include— (1) upholding and defending the Constitution of the United States; (2) collating, preserving, and encouraging the study of historical episodes, chronicles.
